governance.assets: Equipment is scheduled under its parent property policy; no separate equipment sum insured is invented.
governance.claims: No claims, loss events, reserves, adjuster decisions, settlements or payments are invented. Operational registers remain empty until a simulated or verified loss event occurs.
governance.finance: Premiums, reserves, settlements and payments are not posted; BP-34 remains the sole financial posting authority.
governance.insurance: The existing 420 policy records are indexed, not independently underwritten; full policy wording, exclusions, endorsements and site-specific hazard surveys remain future evidence.
governance.maintenance: Known defects are linked as risk exposures, not asserted to have caused an insured loss.
governance.people: No person, resident, employee, claimant or adjuster-person records are created; organisational roles only.
